prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 512x512 in-game boss bust portrait for Sekigahara Ranbu.
Primary request: Draw one fierce, slightly-right-facing head-and-shoulders portrait of Mogami Yoshiaki, matching the attached character sheet exactly.
Subject: Preserve his mature moustached face, dark kabuto with upright gold crescent-like crest, black-gold armor, and rich purple cloak with gold botanical motifs. Frame the entire crest, face, shoulders, and upper chest.
Style/medium: Painted anime-realistic Japanese action-game portrait, crisp dark outlines, detailed lacquer and silk, dramatic restrained lighting.
Composition/framing: One person, centered bust, fill most of the square but leave visible flat-magenta margin around the full silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: Exactly flat pure RGB(255,0,255) / #FF00FF.
Constraints: Keep identity, helmet, armor ornament and colors faithful to the reference. His weapon is a bow; no need to force it into this crop.
Avoid: Text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, border, scenery, extra people, cropped crest or shoulders, gradients, background shadow, watermark.
